company.name: Bemlo
company.shortDescription: AI-native scheduling and workforce management platform for healthcare.
company.description: Bemlo offers a comprehensive AI-native scheduling and workforce management platform, purpose-built for healthcare. At its core is automated scheduling, designed to generate optimal rosters that align both with care demands and individual staff preferences. This not only frees up time for patient care, but also improves the working environment and enables more efficient collaboration across the organization.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven scheduling system that creates optimized staff schedules based on care needs and employee availability and preferences.
